responsibility: Collects the cross-file function prototypes, shared data declarations, and small target-side type definitions used throughout the x86 backend. It is the main internal declaration hub for i386.cc, i386-expand.cc, i386-c.cc, PE/SEH support, scheduling hooks, address decomposition, assembler output helpers, target passes, and related backend services, allowing the large i386 module to share interfaces without circular inclusion through the main target header.
